items.en: Assessments added by hand can be bound to Canvas assignments, and importing an assignment of the same name binds it instead of adding a duplicate.
items.zh: 手动添加的考核可以绑定到 Canvas 作业，导入同名作业时会绑定到已有考核，不再重复添加。

items.en: The `-ocr` image tags are no longer published; use the `-local` tags instead.
items.zh: 不再发布 `-ocr` 镜像标签，请改用 `-local` 标签。

items.en: Auto Dream tidies Sem's memories in the background at most once a day, after a number of new conversations you choose.
items.zh: Auto Dream 每天最多一次在后台整理 Sem 的记忆，频率按新对话数量可调。

items.en: Redesigned the assessment dialog with grouped fields and a switch for leaving an assessment out of the grade.
items.zh: 重新设计了考核对话框：字段分组排列，“不计入成绩”改为开关。

items.en: Redesigned the meeting, event and cancel-or-move dialogs with grouped fields, a weekday picker and one-line time ranges.
items.zh: 重新设计了上课时间、单次事件和停课调课对话框：字段分组排列，星期一键选择，起止时间并为一行。

items.en: Canvas assignment groups are imported into the course's existing grade categories, and remember where you moved them.
items.zh: 导入 Canvas 作业时，作业组会归入课程已有的成绩分类，并记住你调整过的归类。

items.en: Fixed Sem and MCP clients failing to look up assessments by name in courses that use grading categories.
items.zh: 修复了课程设有成绩分类时，Sem 和 MCP 客户端按名称查找考核失败的问题。

items.en: When a tool fails on the server, Sem and MCP clients are told to get the information another way instead of retrying.
items.zh: 工具在服务器端出错时，Sem 和 MCP 客户端会被提示改用其他方式获取信息，而不是反复重试。

items.en: Self-hosted servers use less memory, and the images are slightly smaller.
items.zh: 自部署的服务器占用更少内存，镜像也略小一些。
